name: craft-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog and WebGL/Three.js effects (craft-layer); browser design sessions, visual decisions rendered with the project's own components in any UI library, and live component-registry MCP sourcing (design-studio); plus the companion the studio requires: ui-ux, which carries the WCAG audit. Split out of frontend-suite so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /craft-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.
